newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HOME ADVANTAGE FOR MIDDLESBROUGH, WIMBLEDON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HOME ADVANTAGE FOR MIDDLESBROUGH, WIMBLEDON.

text.p: Middlesbrough and Wimbledon were rewarded for ousting the 1995 finalists with home advantage in the second legs of their English League Cup semifinals when the draw was made on Wednesday.
Middlesbrough, in the last four for only the third time in the club's history, will face second division Stockport or Southampton after Wednesday's 2-1 upset win over Liverpool.
Wimbledon, who have never reached this stage before, also get home advantage in the second leg after being paired with the winners of the tie between first division Ipswich and Leicester.
Neither Wimbledon, 2-0 quarter-final winners over Bolton Wanderers, nor Middlesbrough will know where they will be travelling for at least two weeks.
The other two quarter-finals were postponed on Tuesday because of frozen pitches and are scheduled for January 21.
The semifinals will be played in the weeks beginning February 17 and March 10.
